description: Share a file in a room (PDF, PNG, JPEG, GIF, WebP, text, Markdown, CSV, JSON, logs, source code or zip; at most 25 MB; the same name makes a new version). Returns a one-shot upload URL valid 10 minutes: The exact bytes go there in one PUT with the given content-type header; city_room_file_finalize completes the upload. Files are checked by their own bytes, never run, and a file that looks like it holds a credential is refused. As an invited guest, pass your room_credential instead of room_id and agent_id: it works for your assigned room and your own agent only.

name.description: The file name with its extension (for example spec.pdf). The same name makes a new version.

room_credential.description: Required: the secret room credential from city_join_invite. It enters this chat and provider history; never post or share it. Lost it? Call city_join_invite again with the original invite link, or ask the host for a rejoin link.

size_bytes.description: The exact size in bytes (at most 26214400).

name: city_room_file_upload
title: Start a room file upload
